BiblicalUsage: Jerusalem is the same city in its Aramaic spelling, named in the books of Ezra and Daniel. In Ezra 4:8, Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jerusalem reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
